title: The Best End
description: A mod that shows what a Mojang end update would look like.
body:
# FOR THIS MOD TO WORK, YOU NEED TO INSTALL -
Geckolib 4.7.6 - 1.21.1

Curios API 9.5.1 - 1.21.1

## This Mod Also supports JEI
 

Let me show you what this mod has to offer: - 

For a start, let me tell you the new biomes I added -

![Isolated Islands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34f66fec037301c6c2b1cc4fcc65d9194a933482_0.webp)

# Here's a full list of what the **Isolated Islands** offer - 

1. Pink Lichen (Block)
2. Overgrown Pink Lichen (Block)
3. A Woodset - Shadowpine (Blocks)
4. Bioluminescent Chorus Fruit (Block)
5. Chorus Torch (Block)
6. End Floating Tower (Structure)
7. Departed End Ship (Structure)
8. End Floating Farm (Structure)
9. End Whale (Mob) - Can be ridden

![Devoid](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8417aa6287b7a1685da98391c3dd7b8ed83d779a_0.webp)

# Here's a list of what the **Devoid** offers -

1. Void Block (Block)
2. Void Crystal (Block)
3. Void Herbage (Block)
4. Gleam (Block)
5. Gleam Fruit (Item) - When eaten, the player gives off a subtle glow
6. Void Shards (Item) - Can be used to craft a Vacuo Ampul and an End Portal Frame
7. Vacuo Ampul (Item) - Can be used to store a specific amount of XP

![Drift Lands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a20df1c0c043b15f41d660420dd750db5027b55d_0.webp)

# Here's a list of what the **Drift Lands** offer -
1. Drift Stone (Block)
2. FloatShroom Stem (Block) - If a player jumps off a FloatShroom Stem, the player will get Slow Falling until they reach the ground
3. FloatShroom (Block) - If a player steps on a FloatShroom, they will be shot up into the sky
4. Hover Bush (Block)
5. Hover Berries (Item)
6. End Gravitate (Structure) - See more

![End Gravitate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7c237449b82769545ec5a9d9a85543ede8c89644_0.webp)

The **End Gravitate** is the end's equivalent of a trial chamber. However, to get loot from the end vaults, a player needs to put in the drops of the enemies that spawn in the gravitate. These enemies include -

# The Endersent
![Endersent](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/80971f0e5dc280f0a6298ceba16441ed9cc5566f_0.webp)

# The Drift
![Drift](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c31157c541dd176e3b1e7404e84b7f220845a25f.png)

# The Obsidian Golem - You cannot make this golem before entering the end
![Obsidian Golem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8b4bbe9fcae147c5a26c7398c910fdbcd9c18d41.png)

Hint - Look at the advancement you get from this mob, and try to use Crying Obsidian.
